physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the heart, which is fitting in a way that almost feels too plain to say. The card that runs from constriction to universal love sits in the muscle that carries blood out to every part of you and pulls it back again. The same beat your whole life. The organ that does not know how to stop.

The shadow has its bodily floor here. The tightness sits high in the chest and a little under it, and the breath stops short of where it could go. The vessels themselves narrow when fear runs the show, and over years the body learns the narrower setting as if it were the resting one. A person who lives long enough in this setting forgets there is another. The grip is in the tissue, not only in the mood.

The climb is also bodily, and it is small at first. The breath drops a finger lower. The chest softens around something it had been holding. Warmth spreads where the cold place used to sit. None of this is a feeling about the heart. It is the heart, doing what it does when it is no longer being squeezed against. The work is not to open the heart. The heart was never closed. The work is to stop closing around it, and the body knows the difference long before the mind does.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the organ, this code answers to a single amino acid, Arginine. Arginine is what the body uses to make nitric oxide, the small molecule that tells the vessel walls to relax and let the blood through. Without it the channels narrow. With it they widen. The chemistry of softening is literal. It is happening, or not happening, in the lining of every artery you have, right now.

There is a teaching in that. The card spends three thousand words on the unwinding of constriction, and the body has been doing the same thing in miniature since the day you were born, vessel by vessel, breath by breath. The acceptance the card asks for is not a mystery the body has to learn. It is a chemistry the body already runs. What is asked is that you stop overriding it. The code runs all the way to this: the softening you are looking for is already the floor of you.
